summary: Immutep Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting receipt of a Nasdaq bid price deficiency notice under Listing Rule 5450(a)(1) due to its ADS closing bid price remaining below $1.00 for 30 consecutive business days ended April 24, 2026. The filing is a routine regulatory compliance disclosure, not a special situation event. The company has a 180-day grace period through October 26, 2026, to regain compliance; no definitive action plan, board recommendation, or advisor is named. There are no deal terms; this is a standard notification with no imminent transaction.
